component.module_version_boundary: The frozen moviepy 2.2.1 wheel reports moviepy.__version__ as 2.1.2. Distribution metadata controls dependency identity; the module value is preserved and reported as an observed upstream inconsistency.

patcher.input_policy: Accept only the exact frozen upstream writer plus RECORD pair or the exact patched writer plus RECORD pair after validating frozen METADATA, module version and MIT license identities.
patcher.write_policy: Stage each changed payload in the destination directory, fsync it, and replace it atomically; restore the writer if the RECORD replacement fails. Unknown or mixed states are never written.

modified_file_notice: MIT modification notice: Shanghai Shiyi Brand Management Co., Ltd. modified this file via shiyi-moviepy-windows-mf v1.0.0 for the fixed Windows Media Foundation H.264 policy. This is not the unmodified upstream MoviePy file.

purposes: embed an MIT modified-file notice and patch identity near the top of the source
omit MoviePy's unsupported -preset argument only when codec is h264_mf
append the fixed Media Foundation encoder policy after caller-supplied FFmpeg options
ignore MoviePy's generic bitrate parameter for h264_mf so it cannot silently alter the quality-mode policy

modified_files.purpose: keep installed-distribution RECORD integrity consistent with the modified writer

codec_contract.preset_policy: No -preset argument is emitted for codec=h264_mf; other MoviePy codecs preserve upstream behavior.
codec_contract.audio_policy: Unchanged; callers may continue to request native FFmpeg AAC independently of this video-writer patch.

staging_steps: copy and prune the frozen Python runtime into package staging
run the patcher against staged runtime/python
generate the Python distribution SBOM only after the patched writer and synchronized RECORD are final

runtime_canary.operation: MoviePy ColorClip with generated audio through write_videofile(codec='h264_mf', audio_codec='aac')

formal_packaging_contract.forbidden_delivery_state: A runtime with an unknown or mixed writer/RECORD identity, a missing MIT license, a changed distribution identity, or an unverified patch is not a release input.
